senses.def: A kind of diagram used to classify igneous rocks based on their mineral composition.
A phrase said to wish somebody good fortune, particularly fortune in some form of honourable battle.
ex: Thank you for all the years of patiently being there, especially on those dark and stormy nights when things detonated unexpectedly and I needed rescuing yet again. Qapla'!

2004, Trey Parker, Matt Stone, and Pam Brady, Team America: World Police, Paramount Pictures
Sean Penn: Qapla’!

senses.def: A unit of currency equivalent to a hundredth of an Azerbaijani manat.
ex: Bus 116 runs every 30 minutes, […] The fare is 30 qapik (€0.30).
